page.content:
Babysitter who survives the night and later fortifies against it.

How Laurie Strode connects

  • Creator: Jamie Lee Curtis — Jamie Lee Curtis originated and returned as Laurie Strode.
  • Work: Halloween (1978) — The 1978 film is Laurie's first fight with the Shape.
  • Faction: Strode family — Laurie is the Strode survivor at the center of the cycle.
  • Character: Michael Myers — Laurie is the first babysitter who fights Michael and lives.
  • Work: Halloween (2018) — The 2018 film recenters Laurie as a prepared survivor.
  • Work: Halloween Ends — Halloween Ends finishes Laurie's late war with Michael.
  • Character: Tommy Doyle — Tommy is the child Laurie protects that night.
  • Character: Lynda Van Der Klok — Lynda is one of Laurie's friends killed that night.

What is Laurie Strode?

Laurie Strode is the bookish babysitter who fights Michael in 1978, then returns in later films as a traumatized survivor training for his next coming.

Key threads lead to Jamie Lee Curtis, Halloween (1978), Strode family, Michael Myers, Halloween (2018) and Halloween Ends.
